title: ADR-0157 D1: add a dated note naming the calendar's maintained_from field (the past-side bound)
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6Ca1jJvsA1dHsPwMiQb

Area: data-1 · follow-up of #35355 (PR #35641 contract review 7023325199, design choice 2; seat ruling on #35355)

## 维护者速读
- **问题：** 工作日历新增了一个“维护起始日”字段，用来拒绝早于它的日期计算；架构决策文档里列出的字段清单还没有这一项。
- **要做：** 在该决策文档的字段条目下补一条带日期的说明，写明这个字段和它的拒绝规则。
- **不做会怎样：** 读决策文档的人以为日历只有“维护到期日”一个边界，和实际行为对不上。
- **你要做的：** 这是受治理文档的改动，需要维护者合并。

## What
ADR-0157 D1 lists the fields of `sys_work_calendar`. #35355 (PR #35641 / #35642) adds a required `maintained_from`, the past-side bound: a date before it is refused the same way D8 refuses a date past `maintained_through` (`ERR_WORK_CALENDAR_NOT_MAINTAINED`). The contract review accepted the field (design choice 2) and noted that D1 does not name it, so the ADR owes a dated note by the hand that owns it. The note was kept out of #35641/#35642 so neither becomes Tier H.

## Done when
ADR-0157 D1 carries a dated note naming `maintained_from`, what it bounds, and that a record dated before it reads as not maintained (the D8 consequence on the past side). Lands after #35641 and #35642.

Grade: `area:data · Docs · reach: readers of ADR-0157 · evidence: read (contract review 7023325199)` → p3.
